identification: Two full-size timber letterpress printer's type case drawers (job/lay cases), photographed standing on end: left one darker with three banks of small uniform compartments (about 150+ cells), right one lighter with larger compartments; each has a black metal pull handle on the long side. Roughly 80 x 40 cm each judging by the proportions. Typical early-mid 20th century Australian/English printers' cases, now sold as wall shadow-box display trays.
